user_saw: After a yield, several finished child agents' results never came back to the parent chat (and sometimes no failure notice appeared) because one sibling in the batch had no live Gateway binding.
summary: Partitions frozen subagent completion batches by Gateway owner and retirement state, captures the caller's Gateway binding for visible spawns and watched follow-ups, and consolidates the batch failure notice so bound siblings deliver independently.
reasoning: At the fix parent, getSharedGatewayContextResolver throws 'incompatible Gateway bindings: bound and unbound owners' for a mixed batch, and visible spawn / sessions_send follow-up registration never passed gatewayContextResolver, so mixed batches failed whole; this is an interaction between batch settlement, restoration (which drops in-memory bindings) and paths that never captured a binding. The throw predates the file's creation in c69b8b98 (#153508, a large move) and I could not trace the introducing commit or establish that mixed batches ever worked, and the blame candidates (deslop refactor, #163195, #129535, #198807) touch peripheral lines rather than the failing mechanism.
